title: Canonical launcher portability: remove machine-specific absolute paths
goal: Keep canonical launch chain scripts/start_production.ps1→run_supervised.py and remove machine-specific absolute path assumptions. Do not broaden into routes/Evidence/FK/database work.
root_cause: scripts/start_production.ps1 contains stale machine-specific root D:\Taikoo-monitor-new.
implementation_steps: Inspect only the two launchers for machine-specific absolute-path anchors
Replace with repository-relative/environment-configurable resolution while preserving idempotency/health/browser safeguards
Launch with isolated ZBC_DB_PATH and verify 0.0.0.0:8201 plus /healthz=200

minimal_test_commands.Level_D_phase_regression: See test router only at phase gate
minimal_test_commands.Level_E_full_suite_GATE_ONLY: python -m pytest tests -m "not online" -q only at gate

runtime_probe: Set isolated ZBC_DB_PATH; powershell scripts/start_production.ps1; GET http://127.0.0.1:8201/healthz
expected_after: No machine-specific launcher root; canonical default runtime starts on 0.0.0.0:8201 and healthz=200; env/repository-relative resolution works.
acceptance_criteria: Portable launcher verified without unrelated behavior changes; required before RC.
